name: Márok (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Márok (a crowned red shield with a white chevron and a bunch of grapes, with yellow and blue mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed MÁROK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Márok arms with crown, mantling and scroll
